name: bug-fix
description: Reproduce the bug with a failing test, fix it, verify, and review; a rejected review sends the fix back (up to 2 times).

stages.name: Reproduce
stages.promptTemplate:
Bug report: {task}

Reproduce the bug and write a failing automated test that demonstrates it. Do not fix the bug. Report the test name and the failure message.

stages.name: Fix
Verify
Review
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the fix for: {task}

Check that it addresses the root cause, not just the symptom, and that the test is meaningful. Answer with an outcome.
